title: Jensen Huang Gets Roasted by SNL
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

Too soon?

I guess it is an honor in some circles, it certainly is in mine since my wife and I grew up with SNL. We still watch it but we fast forward a lot more than before. Anything political gets skipped because rarely is it funny. I do like the weekend Updates, they have always been my favorite back to the days when Jane Curtin and Dan Aykroyd were the first hosts. "Jane you ignorant slut" was the funniest thing ever back in 1977. I was in high school so it was dead center in my teenage joke lane. My friends and I called each other ignorant sluts for the longest time after that. But I digress....

0:07
"Well, the FAA suddenly and mysteriously grounded all US flights yesterday. Oh, thank God. A different news story, said Jensen Huang."

1:22
Elon Musk was criticized for his speech at a rally after the inauguration in which he appears to give the Nazi salute. But come on, Elon Musk is not a Nazi. The Nazis made nice cars.

4:15
The Jensen Hong sex scandal has sent Nvidia's stock tumbling, which is scaring financial experts since Nvidia's chips are powering the AI boom that is propping up the entire US economy. Which means Jensen Hong had a midlife crisis so bad you might lose your house in his divorce.

5:28
Experts are saying that Nvidia CEO Jensen Wong's affair with an alleged spy is an example of a honey trap, which is when a beautiful woman is used to get close to an unsuspecting target. The technique is called honey trap because it was invented by a pimp named Honey Trap. Jensen Wong agreed to testify before Congress about his extramarital affairs. Anything to avoid going home.
